# Flows

*Describes silverpoint 0.7.0.*

2 charts. Shared props, the data shapes and the recommender are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md).

**Contents:** [SankeyChart](#sankeychart) · [ChordRing](#chordring)

## SankeyChart

`sankey-chart` · Flow bands between layered nodes.

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `SankeyChart` | `SpSankeyChart` | `sp-sankey-chart` | `sankey_chart` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/sankey-chart` | `@silverpoint/vue/sankey-chart` | `@silverpoint/angular/sankey-chart` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Data:** shape `links`; intents `flow`, `part-to-whole`.

| Role | Accessor prop | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| source | `sourceKey` | string | yes |
| target | `targetKey` | string | yes |
| value | `valueKey` | number | yes |

The demo's first rows, drawn when `data` is omitted:

```json
[ { "source": "Search", "target": "Visit", "value": 48 }, { "source": "Social", "target": "Visit", "value": 27 }, { "source": "Email", "target": "Visit", "value": 15 } ]
```

### Props

Its own props; the 23 common ones are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md#common-chart-props).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sourceKey` | `Accessor<string>` | `'source'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `targetKey` | `Accessor<string>` | `'target'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `valueKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'value'` | Ignored without `data`. |

### Example

```tsx
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import { SankeyChart } from '@silverpoint/react/sankey-chart';

export function SankeyChartView({ rows }: { rows: readonly Record<string, unknown>[] }) {
  return (
    <SankeyChart
      data={rows}
      sourceKey="source"
      targetKey="target"
      valueKey="value"
      title="Sankey chart"
    />
  );
}
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import { SpSankeyChart } from '@silverpoint/vue/sankey-chart';

defineProps<{ rows: readonly Record<string, unknown>[] }>();
</script>

<template>
  <SpSankeyChart
    :data="rows"
    sourceKey="source"
    targetKey="target"
    valueKey="value"
    title="Sankey chart"
  />
</template>
```

```ts angular
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, input } from '@angular/core';
import { SpSankeyChart } from '@silverpoint/angular/sankey-chart';

/** Add '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css', '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css' to the `styles` of angular.json. */
@Component({
  selector: 'app-sankey-chart-view',
  imports: [SpSankeyChart],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <sp-sankey-chart
      [data]="rows()"
      [sourceKey]="'source'"
      [targetKey]="'target'"
      [valueKey]="'value'"
      [title]="'Sankey chart'"
    />
  `,
})
export class SankeyChartView {
  readonly rows = input.required<readonly Record<string, unknown>[]>();
}
```

## ChordRing

`chord-ring` · Directed flows between categories around a circle.

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `ChordRing` | `SpChordRing` | `sp-chord-ring` | `chord_ring` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/chord-ring` | `@silverpoint/vue/chord-ring` | `@silverpoint/angular/chord-ring` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Data:** shape `links`; intents `flow`, `network`.

| Role | Accessor prop | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| source | `sourceKey` | string | yes |
| target | `targetKey` | string | yes |
| value | `valueKey` | number | yes |

The demo's first rows, drawn when `data` is omitted:

```json
[ { "source": "Home", "target": "Shop", "value": 42 }, { "source": "Home", "target": "Blog", "value": 28 }, { "source": "Blog", "target": "Shop", "value": 16 } ]
```

### Props

Its own props; the 23 common ones are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md#common-chart-props).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sourceKey` | `Accessor<string \| number>` | `'source'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `targetKey` | `Accessor<string \| number>` | `'target'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `valueKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'value'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `maxCategories` | `number` | `12` | Categories drawn; past it the smallest merge into "Other" (`SP010`). 12 by default. |

### Example

```tsx
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import { ChordRing } from '@silverpoint/react/chord-ring';

export function ChordRingView({ rows }: { rows: readonly Record<string, unknown>[] }) {
  return (
    <ChordRing
      data={rows}
      sourceKey="source"
      targetKey="target"
      valueKey="value"
      title="Chord ring"
    />
  );
}
```
